name: Can a tiny home on my property generate rental income?

mainEntity.name: Can a tiny home on my property generate rental income?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a tiny home on your property can generate rental income, especially if it qualifies as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU). ADUs are increasingly popular for their potential to provide a steady income stream or house family members. Before building, it's essential to understand local zoning laws in your specific city (e.g., Escondido, Vista) regarding short-term vs. long-term rentals and any associated occupancy requirements. Zen Tiny Homes designs and builds ADUs that meet local code for safe and compliant rental use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a tiny home, particularly an ADU, can generate rental income. Confirm local zoning laws for rental types and occupancy. Zen Tiny Homes builds ADUs compliant for rental use.
